What I really appreciate is that it helps me see the bigger picture instead of getting caught up in one random weigh-in or one difficult week. When you’re on a GLP-1, progress isn’t always perfectly linear, so having everything tracked in one place has been really motivating. I’ve been using Zepbound as part of a long-term weight-loss journey, and having an app like Shotsy makes me feel more organized and accountable without making the process feel overwhelming.

I love this app! I thought I didn’t need it but after the trial, I knew it was a great tool for my Zepbound journey.  

I love tracking my progress on the app. Also calculating the average of my calories and protein is very helpful. It’s fun to see my weight loss in a chart and showing my total loss. 

Seeing the estimated amount of Zepbound in my body on a daily basis helps me understand what’s going on in my body. 

The one thing I thought I wouldn’t use is the tracking of where I gave my last shot.  I thought I’d remember it. I was wrong. After five weeks I had to check the app to see where my last shot was. I did not remember.

Honestly, I’m writing this at the end of a week free trial and I’m underwhelmed. Firstly, because for a weekly-dosed drug like Zepbound, a week is hardly time enough to see what the potential really is. 

I may be an edge case since at least as I get started I’ve not yet encountered much in the way of side effects worth tracking, but it just doesn’t seem to provide much that a spreadsheet wouldn’t. 

Visualizations are…decent? But aside from the med level graphic they all seem to depend on external data so you still have to choose a calorie/protein tracker, too.

reviews.title: Helps You Stay on Track
reviews.text: I am so glad that I found this app to help me while I am on this journey with Zepbound, specifically. My favorite feature are the graphs that the app generates, it’s a very helpful way to track progress and trends, overtime, and very easy to read. I am especially appreciative of how the app allows you to track both positive and negative symptoms, and to graph those as well. I would highly recommend to anybody who is going to be on a GLP one as a way to help keep you centered, find more easily, keeping track of your progress and symptom trends.

reviews.title: Great for Newbies to GLP-1s!
reviews.text: I started using this when I started Zepbound to track my shots and weight loss journey. I use it every week so that I can vary my shot site and so that I can remember my overall trend. Even though I weigh myself every couple days, it’s important so see the graph over time to remember that this is a long term journey. Really great for beginners! My only criticism is that I wish it had something other than bananas for the loss comparison at the end! I also think it’d be great to add a “dose” translator from mls to units for people who transition from brand name to compound, and for syringes that measure in units instead of mls.
